changes.text: A Craft button on the step you’re on makes its crafts from the road’s card.
A + on each step down the road puts that step alone on your shopping list.
An item’s tooltip says how much better it is for you, under jsal.ui’s own heading.
An × at the end of a row you added takes it off.
A material you can make yourself is listed to make, “make 18”, with how many you have.
Vendor prices are what that vendor charges you, and leather you hold makes the leather you’re short of.
The road names a trainer who’ll teach you the step, in every profession.
“Best for you” goes to the upgrade that adds the most, and a piece’s percent crit or hit counts.
A unique ring or trinket is offered for one slot of the pair.
A weapon master lists only the weapon skills he teaches.
A new build takes a name no other build has, and a greyed Delete says why.
The Gear plan, Dungeon guide and Crafting profit fit a small screen.
A RestedXP step whose new quest has no tag shows the one for the quest it has you do.
The road goes the cheapest way at auction prices, whatever’s in your bags.
The road’s shopping buttons no longer double what’s listed.
The road keeps the step you’re on and lets you finish it.
The source chips stay inside their column.
The New in strip’s first line fits.
